title: Myanmar Investment Commission, Notification No. (12/2020)
text:
The Republic of the Union of Myanmar
Myanmar Investment Commission
Notification No. 12 / 2020
th
13 Waxing of Kasone, 1382 ME
th
( 4 May, 2020 )
Substitution for Member of Taninthayi Region Investment Committee
U Myint Thein, Director of the Department of Land Management and Statistics
has been appointed as the member of Taninthayi Region Investment Committee which
was formed by the Notification No.61/2017 of the Myanmar Investment Commission.
(Thaung Tun)
Chariman
